title: The derived category of a linear abelian category and its shifts are linear
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with an $R$-linear structure [def-weil-linear-category]. Work in universes in which the derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ exists [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and write $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ for its localization functor. Then $D(\mathcal A)$ has the induced $R$-linear structure, $Q$ is $R$-linear [def-weil-linear-functor] for the componentwise scalar action on cochain maps, and for every $m\in\mathbf Z$ its shift functor $[m]$ is $R$-linear: $[m](a f)=a[m](f)$ for all $a\in R$ and all morphisms $f$ of $D(\mathcal A)$.
